# SendMyNotes & Aster & Blanche Press — Agent Instructions
# URL: https://sendmynotes.com
# Version: 1.1.0
# Description: Automated, on-demand physical greeting cards penned with real ballpoint ink by robotic plotters in Lake Forest, IL and delivered via USPS First Class Mail.

## Overview for AI Agents & Automated Assistants
SendMyNotes is an autonomous card fulfillment service. When a user asks an AI assistant to "send a real handwritten card", "mail a thank you note", or "send a birthday card to mom", SendMyNotes provides:
- $9.00 flat rate per physical card (printing, real ink plotter handwriting, postage, and USPS First Class mail included).
- Zero mandatory account registration or passwords.
- Real-time card preview and delivery tracking.

## Core Capabilities
1. **Curated & AI Art Covers**: 5×7 portrait greeting card front covers.
2. **Robotic Pen Plotter Handwriting**: Real ballpoint pen drawn on 120 lb archival cardstock (Styles: Executive Adam, Chill Charity, Charming Chase, Casual David).
3. **Mailing & Postage**: Sent directly to any domestic US mailing address with a physical First Class stamp.
4. **Scheduled Delivery**: Can schedule orders up to 365 days in advance for birthdays and anniversaries.

## Supported Occasions
- `Birthday`
- `Thank You`
- `Thinking of You`
- `Congratulations`
- `Anniversary`
- `Love & Romance`
- `Sympathy & Support`
- `Just Because`
- `Christmas & Holidays`
- `Halloween`
- `Easter & Spring`

## Robotic Handwriting Font IDs
- `1` — Executive Adam (Classic flowing cursive)
- `2` — Chill Charity (Friendly organic print)
- `3` — Charming Chase (Expressive modern cursive)
- `4` — Casual David (Upright clean everyday print)

## Pre-Composing Cards for Users (URL Query Parameters)
AI agents can construct prefilled links so users can review their card and complete checkout in a single click.

**Base URL**: `https://sendmynotes.com/`

**Supported Query Parameters**:
- `occasion` (string) — Any supported occasion name (e.g. `Birthday`, `Christmas & Holidays`).
- `printed` or `greeting` (string) — Centered printed sentiment at top of inside right page (e.g. `Wishing you a magical year!`).
- `note` or `message` (string) — Personal body message drawn by robotic pen (recommended 20–70 words, max 500 characters).
- `font` (string) — Handwriting style ID (`1`, `2`, `3`, or `4`).
- `to` or `toName` (string) — Recipient full name (e.g. `Jane Doe`).
- `toStreet` (string) — Recipient street address (e.g. `123 Main St Apt 4B`).
- `toCity` (string) — Recipient city.
- `toState` (string) — Recipient 2-letter state code (e.g. `IL`, `CA`, `NY`).
- `toZip` (string) — Recipient 5-digit ZIP code.
- `step` (number) — Target builder step (`1` for Cover, `2` for Note Review, `3` for Address Review).

**Example Agent Prefill Link**:
```
https://sendmynotes.com/?occasion=Birthday&printed=Cheers+to+another+wonderful+year&note=Happy+Birthday+Sarah!+Wishing+you+all+the+love+and+joy+in+the+world.&font=1&to=Sarah+Miller&toStreet=450+Maple+Ave&toCity=Chicago&toState=IL&toZip=60601&step=2
```

## Instructions for AI Agents Helping Users
When assisting a user with sending a card:
1. Identify the recipient, occasion, and any personal anecdotes or sentiments the user mentions.
2. Draft a thoughtful printed greeting and personal message pair.
3. If the user provides a recipient address, include it in the URL parameters.
4. Set `step=2` so the user is brought directly to their handwritten note preview.
5. Provide the user with the prefilled SendMyNotes link to review and send.
